description: This file contains unit tests for various model serializers in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing the ModelTrait used by models to serialize entities into arrays with nested support and attribute filtering.

classes.name: ModelTraitTest
classes.description: Test suite for the ModelTrait serialization functionality, verifying array output, nested structures, filtering, and attribute naming.

classes.name: TestJobTitleEntity
classes.description: Mock entity representing a job title with 'name' and 'description'.

classes.name: TestEmployeeEntity
classes.description: Mock entity representing an employee with 'id' and 'jobTitle' (which is a TestJobTitleEntity).

classes.name: TestJobTitleModel
classes.description: Serializer model implementing Normalizable, using ModelTrait, and configured to serialize 'name' by default.

classes.name: TestEmployeeModel
classes.description: Serializer model implementing Normalizable, using ModelTrait, with nested entity serialization for 'jobTitle'.

classes.name: TestModel
classes.description: A simple class utilizing ModelTrait for testing private methods, mainly makeNestedArray.

methods.name: testSetEntity
methods.description: Verifies setting an entity and converting to array outputs 'name' field correctly.

methods.name: testSetFilters
methods.description: Checks that setting filters correctly restricts serialized fields to 'description'.

methods.name: testSetAttributeNames
methods.description: Verifies that attribute name mapping alters keys in the output array accordingly.

methods.name: testToArrayWithChaining
methods.description: Tests nested serialization, filtering, and attribute renaming with chained method calls.

methods.name: testMakeNestedArray
methods.description: Private method test that creates nested arrays from field paths, ensuring correct structure for nested attributes.
